section.content: 本发明提供种半导体集成电路。半导体集成电路包括端子、成二极管连接的MOS晶体管、保护二极管电路、电池放电用MOS晶体管、电池电压检测控制电路、以及过电压保护用箝位电路。电池防电涌MOS晶体管分别连接在端子中的相邻的各端子之间。成二极管连接的MOS晶体管分别连接在端子中相邻的各端子之间。从而，在相邻的端子之间施加了浪涌电压的情况下，能保护连接在相邻的端子之间的电路元件使其不受到因浪涌电压导致的静电破坏。

The present invention provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit.MOS transistor, protection diode circuit, battery discharge MOS transistor, battery voltage detection control circuit and the overvoltage protection clamp circuit that semiconductor integrated circuit includes terminal, is connected at diode.The anti-surge MOS transistor of battery is connected between adjacent each terminal in terminal.The MOS transistor connected at diode is connected between each terminal adjacent in terminal.To in the case of being applied with surge voltage between adjacent terminal, the circuit element between being connected to adjacent terminal be protected to make it not by the electrostatic breakdown caused by surge voltage.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The application is that on March 21st, 2011 submits, application No. is 201110070228.4, entitled " semiconductors The divisional application of the application of integrated circuit ".

Background technology

In recent years, the various equipment or charger using TunePowers such as lithium ion batteries are developed.Correspondingly, The integrated electricity of semiconductor for developing the voltage for multiple batteries that detection is connected in series with, and the voltage of battery being controlled based on the voltage Road.

In this semiconductor integrated circuit, for protecting internal circuit to make it not by the surge for being applied to input terminal Between the protection circuit of the influence of voltage overvoltage and power cord and ground connection, it is provided with clamp circuit.

In patent document 1, it discloses and 1 protection circuit is shared to reduce circuit scale by multiple input terminal Semiconductor integrated circuit.In patent document 2, the circuit for cutting down the clamp circuit being arranged between power cord and ground connection is disclosed The semiconductor integrated circuit of area.

Patent document 1：Japanese Unexamined Patent Publication 2001-267496 bulletins

Patent document 2：Japanese Unexamined Patent Publication 2009-104455 bulletins

But it in the semiconductor integrated circuit of above-mentioned battery control, is connected between adjacent terminal sometimes Circuit element.For example, in order to make battery discharge, the connecting valve element between 2 adjacent input terminals.Also, it is switching When element switches, the plus end and negative terminal of battery are short-circuited, and to which battery is discharged, the voltage of battery reduces.Such In semiconductor integrated circuit, the problem of there is switch element can be destroyed when being applied in surge voltage between input terminal.

Invention content

The semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention is carried out in view of the above subject, which has multiple ends Son is separately connected battery between adjacent terminal, which is characterized in that having：Circuit element connects It is connected between adjacent terminal；And overvoltage protection element, it is connected between adjacent terminal, the circuit element is protected to make It is not influenced by the overvoltage applied between adjacent terminal.

In addition, the semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention, has at least the 1st to the 3rd terminal, the 1st terminal and the 2nd terminal it Between connect the 1st battery, the 2nd battery is connected between the 2nd terminal and the 3rd terminal, which is characterized in that, has It is standby：1st circuit element is connected between the 1st terminal and the 2nd terminal；1st overvoltage protection element is connected to the 1st terminal Between the 2nd terminal, protect the 1st circuit element that it is made not influenced by overvoltage；2nd circuit element, is connected to Between 2nd terminal and the 3rd terminal；2nd overvoltage protection element is connected between the 2nd terminal and the 3rd terminal, described in protection 2nd circuit element makes it not influenced by overvoltage；Protection diode circuit is connect with the 2nd terminal；With the 3rd overvoltage Protection element is connected between the 1st terminal and the 3rd terminal.
